name.zh: 环氧平涂面漆涂装系统

intro.zh: 环氧平涂面漆为双组份、无接缝的平涂型环氧树脂地坪面漆，用于普通环氧地坪和环氧砂浆地坪涂装系统的薄涂型面层；本系列包括溶剂型、无溶剂及桔纹防滑面漆。
intro.en: Epoxy flat topcoats are two-component, seamless thin-film finish coats for ordinary epoxy and epoxy mortar flooring systems; the range includes solvent-based, solvent-free and orange-peel anti-slip topcoats.

summary.zh: 溶剂型环氧面漆（A组份 BATOV-3001）与配套环氧面漆固化剂（B组份 BATOV-G301），主要用于地坪漆的面涂层涂装，是一种溶剂型、双组份、色彩多样化、无接缝的高性能平涂型环氧树脂地坪面漆。涂装表面平滑美观、颜色一致、持久耐用；干燥后无气味、无毒无害。适用于环氧树脂地坪涂装系统薄涂型面漆，一般需要两遍涂装工序。
summary.en: Solvent-based epoxy topcoat (Part A BATOV-3001) with epoxy topcoat hardener (Part B BATOV-G301), mainly used as the finish coat of flooring systems. A solvent-based, two-component, high-performance, seamless flat epoxy topcoat available in many colors, giving a smooth, attractive, uniform and durable surface; odorless and non-toxic once dry. Suitable as the thin-film topcoat of epoxy flooring systems; normally two coats.

uses.zh: 用于普通环氧树脂地坪涂装系统和环氧砂浆地坪涂装系统，适用于电器、电子、食品、医药、化工、机械等行业的制造车间和停车场、办公室、商场、仓库等场所的水泥或水磨石地面的首选涂装体系
uses.en: For ordinary epoxy and epoxy mortar flooring systems: preferred coating system for cement or terrazzo floors in manufacturing workshops (electrical, electronics, food, pharmaceutical, chemical, machinery), car parks, offices, shops and warehouses

zh: 防尘、防潮、耐磨，容易清洁
耐弱酸、弱碱、盐和油的腐蚀
en: Dust-proof, moisture-proof, abrasion resistant, easy to clean
Resistant to weak acids, weak alkalis, salt and oil

v.zh: 环境温度 10～35℃ 施工时允许加入不超过涂料重量 3% 的 BATOV-X001（面漆稀释剂），灰色等面漆加入不超过 2% 的 BATOV-X002（灰色面漆专用稀释剂）；施工温度 5～10℃ 时，可加入不超过涂料重量 2% 的 BATOV-X001，灰色面漆不超过 1% 的 BATOV-X002
v.en: At 10–35 °C ambient, up to 3% by weight of BATOV-X001 (topcoat thinner) may be added, and up to 2% of BATOV-X002 (special thinner for grey topcoat) for grey and similar colors; at 5–10 °C, up to 2% BATOV-X001 and up to 1% BATOV-X002 for grey

v.zh: BATOV-X001（面漆稀释剂）
v.en: BATOV-X001 (topcoat thinner)

v.zh: 刮刀披刮或滚筒滚涂。素地平整、光滑、强度好采用刮刀披刮；素地起砂、毛糙、强度差采用滚筒滚涂
v.en: Squeegee/trowel or roller. Use a squeegee on flat, smooth, strong substrates; use a roller on dusting, rough or weak substrates

v.zh: 5～35℃；基面温度至少高于空气露点温度 3℃ 以上；环境温度高于 35℃ 一般不建议施工
v.en: 5–35 °C; substrate at least 3 °C above dew point; application above 35 °C generally not recommended

v.zh: 应确保施工场所通风无尘，但不应有强风，以免带进灰尘影响表观效果
v.en: Keep the area ventilated and dust-free, without strong wind that blows in dust and spoils the finish

v.zh: 干燥时间在标准条件（25℃，60% 湿度）下测定，仅供参考；不同温度和湿度下差异较大，还受漆膜厚度、通风状况、下层涂料等影响。温度升高干燥时间缩短，温度降低则加长
v.en: Drying times measured at 25 °C, 60% RH, for reference only; they vary with temperature, humidity, film thickness, ventilation and substrate coating (shorter when warmer, longer when colder)

v.zh: 涂料密封储存在干燥、阴凉、通风良好的条件，避免高温和火源；运输时保证车厢环境干燥、封闭，材料码放平稳
v.en: Store sealed in a dry, cool, well-ventilated place away from heat and fire; keep the vehicle dry and enclosed in transit and stack stably

v.zh: A组份 BATOV-3001 : B组份 BATOV-G301 = 3:1，混合后充分搅拌均匀
v.en: Part A BATOV-3001 : Part B BATOV-G301 = 3:1; mix thoroughly

v.zh: 一般需要两遍涂装工序
v.en: Normally two coats

v.zh: 混合后可使用时间（25℃）20 分钟，倒在地面可使用时间为 40 分钟
v.en: Pot life 20 min at 25 °C; 40 min once poured on the floor

summary.zh: 无溶剂环氧面漆（A组份 BATOV-3002）与配套环氧面漆固化剂（B组份 BATOV-G302），主要用于地坪漆的面涂层涂装，是一种无溶剂型、双组份、色彩多样化、无VOC、气味小、无接缝的高性能平涂型环氧树脂地坪面漆。涂装表面平滑美观、颜色一致、持久耐用、漆膜饱和丰满；干燥后无气味、无毒无害。适用于环氧树脂地坪涂装系统薄涂型面漆，一般需要一遍涂装工序。
summary.en: Solvent-free epoxy topcoat (Part A BATOV-3002) with epoxy topcoat hardener (Part B BATOV-G302), mainly used as the finish coat of flooring systems. A solvent-free, two-component, high-performance, seamless flat epoxy topcoat available in many colors, VOC-free with low odor, giving a smooth, uniform, durable, full-bodied film; odorless and non-toxic once dry. Suitable as the thin-film topcoat of epoxy flooring systems; normally one coat.

uses.zh: 用于普通环氧树脂地坪涂装系统和环氧砂浆地坪涂装系统，适用于电器、电子、食品、医药、化工、机械等行业的制造车间和停车场、办公室、商场、仓库等场所的水泥或水磨石地面的首选涂装体系
uses.en: For ordinary epoxy and epoxy mortar flooring systems: preferred coating system for cement or terrazzo floors in manufacturing workshops (electrical, electronics, food, pharmaceutical, chemical, machinery), car parks, offices, shops and warehouses

zh: 防尘、防潮、耐磨，容易清洁
耐弱酸、弱碱、盐和油的腐蚀
漆膜饱满度优异、流平性好
en: Dust-proof, moisture-proof, abrasion resistant, easy to clean
Resistant to weak acids, weak alkalis, salt and oil
Excellent film fullness and good leveling

summary.zh: 环氧桔纹防滑面漆（A组份 BATOV-3003）与配套环氧面漆固化剂（B组份 BATOV-G303），主要用于防滑或特殊效果地坪漆的面涂层涂装，是一种基于改性胺固化、采用进口原材料配制的高粘度、低VOC、双组份、涂层抗压强度高、耐磨、持久耐用，具有桔纹效果的高性能平涂型环氧树脂地坪面漆。涂装表面呈现桔纹状、颜色一致、漆膜饱和丰满；干燥后无气味、无毒无害。适用于环氧树脂地坪涂装系统薄涂型面漆，一般需要一遍涂装工序。
summary.en: Epoxy orange-peel anti-slip topcoat (Part A BATOV-3003) with epoxy topcoat hardener (Part B BATOV-G303), mainly used as the finish coat for anti-slip or special-effect floors. A modified-amine-cured, two-component, high-viscosity, low-VOC, high-performance flat epoxy topcoat made with imported raw materials, with high compressive strength, abrasion resistance and durability, giving an orange-peel texture; uniform color, full-bodied film; odorless and non-toxic once dry. Normally one coat.

uses.zh: 用于普通环氧树脂地坪涂装系统和环氧砂浆地坪涂装系统，适用于要求防滑的车库、厂房、人行道、食品厂、肉联厂、食堂等地坪
uses.en: For ordinary epoxy and epoxy mortar flooring systems; suitable for floors requiring slip resistance such as garages, workshops, walkways, food plants, meat-processing plants and canteens

Resistant to weak acids, weak alkalis, salt and oil
